article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article135Three years.

The Schedule  ·  Third Division—Applications · Part I—Applications in Specified Cases
For the enforcement of a decree granting a mandatory injunction.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of the decree or where a date is fixed for performance, such date.
